QuestInfo.name: Camila's Testimony
QuestInfo.0: This is your second assignment as an informant. Who stuck this puppet on the monsters near\n#m100000000#? Talk to #b#p1012003##k in #b#m100000000##k for more information.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012003# says to ask #b#p1012108##k in #m100000000# if she saw who put the puppet on the #o5130101#.
QuestInfo.2: #p1012108# says a weird kid showed up in Henesys just before the monsters turned strange. The kid had a puppet with him, too...

0.0: Come to think of it, #b#p1012108##k might know something. She's the one who got kidnapped by the Golem, after all.

yes.0: Can you ask #p1012108# if she knows anything about who put the puppet on the Golems? She'll tell you whatever she knows as long as you're polite.

no.0: You don't know #p1012108#? She'll be near the portal on the right side of town.

1.0: Hi, can I help you?\r\n#L0##b(Camila, have you seen anyone strange around the Golems?#l\n#k
1.1: Anyone strange? Hm, not really... There are always a lot of people that pass #m100040000#, so it's hard to remember everyone.\r\n#L0##bI'm looking for someone with puppets that-#l\n#k
1.2: Puppets? Why didn't you say so? There was that #bweird kid with all the puppets#k that passed through not too long ago. Come to think of it, that was right before the monsters around #m100000000# started getting strange...

0.msg: I've seen a lot of weird mushroom monsters, too. Why do you think the monsters changed so much?

1.msg: #b(#m100000000# has been struggling with an influx of strange monsters. Talk to #p1012003#.)#k
